profile.name: Cristian Arce
profile.summary: Software engineer who started back-end on ERP systems and moved to the front-end, where the pace of the web stack kept his attention. Now leads web practice work: design systems, micro frontends, and the people building them.
profile.credo: I teach others the way I wish I had been taught.

items.name: AI
items.detail: Self-taught from 2025, and now going into projects. The newest line on the chart by a wide margin — when one of those projects is worth writing up, it will appear in Work rather than as a longer skills list.

roles.title: Senior Lead Web Developer — Practice Lead
highlights: Led the front-end of client applications built on design systems, integrating with microservice APIs.
Improved and optimised micro frontends across JS frameworks.
Designed and implemented CI/CD with platform teams; supported production deploys, hot fixes and enhancements.
Mentorship, career-path support and candidate evaluation; drove web initiatives across the company.
Worked with product managers to shape solutions, running scrum/kanban and writing backlog stories.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
highlights: Took client products from ideation through deployment, working across teams in different countries and regions.
Built and integrated REST services against user requirements, coding standards and code review.
Supported and fixed existing database structures — stored procedures, views, triggers and tables — in SQL Server, MySQL and Oracle.
Applied agile methodologies to deliver features from a backlog of user stories.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.context: clients across Central America and the Caribbean
highlights: Analysis, design and enhancement of Exactus ERP modules: Point-of-Sales, Electronic Invoice and Electronic CRM.
Functional and technical ERP support across front-end and back-end.
Software and database UAT and functional testing for enhancements and bug fixes.
